summary:
(Bloomberg Opinion) -- A low-profile U.K. company serving the private jet business is suddenly making some very big friends.

Funds managed by Blackstone Group Inc. have teamed up with Microsoft Corp. co-founder Bill Gates in an attempted $4.3 billion bid for Signature Aviation Plc. It’s a formidable partnership that rival investment fund suitors Carlyle Group Inc. and Global Infrastructure Partners will have a tough job seeing off.
